headline: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen improves AI Mode's complex-query answers
summary: Google says its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model makes AI Mode better at understanding complex, multi-part questions, breaking them into parts and answering each one, while surfacing more relevant links and richer visual responses. The upgrade is rolling out today across Search, the Gemini app and all Google subscription tiers.
